author: StewieFG
body:
Hello!

Lately, I have seen alot of players being banned for ban evading.
I think the best solution to reduce the ban evading punishments is to IP-ban / IP-tempban players instead of normally benning them. That'll reduce the number of the ban evading punishments, nad only in a case that they use a VPN, they will get banned for ban evading, it still helps to reduce the ban evading punishments. Just instead of /ban or /tempban, there will be /ipban, /iptempban.

Feedback below :)
